query: ¿Un subagente puede lanzar sus propios subagentes? Quiero que mi lanzador headless no pueda hacerlo bajo ninguna circunstancia.
expected_behavior: Routes to reference/dispatching.md (and headless-launcher.md for the fork-bomb context)
States that nesting is allowed by default: three layers below the main session, controlled by CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH; forks keep the Agent tool at the limit
Prescribes the policy: keep Agent out of the lobo's tools list AND set the depth to 1 for the headless launcher, plus the SDK availability filter (tools: [...] without Agent/Workflow)
notes: Corrects the old claim that the pack is flat by nature; a flat pack is enforced, not assumed.
